items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: So Roy Milton, the great Blues singer and drummer, he had his fine group there, with Jose Sep(?) and Camille Howard and Buddy Floyd

ctx.x: That was quite an experience, because the Canadian people were so aware of the musicians and the music that came from America, and it was kind of astounding that people walked up to me and called me by my name, way up in Canada, you know...! I said, "Wow!" If you did anything at all, they knew about you, you know, up there at the dance... And they really, really appreciated the music, you know.

Previous to that, I had met Roy Milton. I used to go down to the Cobra Room there at First and San Pedro and sit in with them sometimes. Like, Monday nights, on my off night, I'd get around and play with different guys. So Roy Milton, the great Blues singer and drummer, he had his fine group there, with Jose Sep(?) and Camille Howard and Buddy Floyd, the tenor saxophonist, and Cato(?) was the bass player.
